limitations: Isolated headless Linux Chromium at 320×740 and 390×844 in Turkish and English; Classic/Feyz. This is not physical Samsung/Android touch, audible playback, screen lock or service-worker update acceptance.

Native trusted switch/help/disclosure/keyboard/range inputs exercise unchanged production code. Setup, unlock/revocation, reading dialog and test session selection use explicitly labelled public production APIs.

Foreground cases store generated 30-second PCM tones only in disposable personal-recording slots. Native play/pause/currentTime are observed, not replaced. Device speech is the existing controlled fixture and must not replace those tones.
A real production frequency provider verifies global Pause retention. Services workers and external traffic are blocked. Screenshots are local QA evidence only.
